items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I had moved over to 32nd and Dearborn, to a lady named Miss Bern, Cora Dern. And she let me stay there.

ctx.x: And so they'd say, "Get her out of here. My God, I'll get my license taken away from here. Get her out of here." I was so little, you know. And so they'd put me out, each place I'd go. I went to the different places where Birk and Cora Greene and the different ones were working, and they'd make fun of me. But I kept going. You know, I'm very determined. I kept going. I'd go back every night. So finally, I think I sang a song down there, down to Dago Frank's. And the man, Roy, his name was Roy, he was the manager,…
